title: Nitro Surge: Neon Highway - Near-miss neon racing
short: Race an endless synthwave highway at sunset.
desc:
No brakes. Just an endless neon highway at sunset.

Tap the left or right side of the screen to change lanes and slip past traffic by a hair. Every close pass scores a NEAR MISS, builds your combo and fills your nitro. Hold the NITRO button for a burst of speed.

· Near-miss combos: chain close passes to push your multiplier up to x10.
· Clean passes: clear a whole traffic pattern (convoys, zigzags, narrow gates) without a scratch for a CLEAN bonus.
· Yellow wings: grab them to fly over traffic for 4 seconds. Ramps on the road give you a short jump.
· Six zones: Sunset Drive, Neon City, Aurora Pass, Inferno Run, Ocean Drive and Gold Rush, each one faster than the last.
· Three hearts: lose one per crash, and pick up repairs to get them back.

Set a nickname to post your best run on the optional leaderboard. "Delete my data" on the leaderboard screen removes your server record at any time.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases and no sign-in.

This game was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
